{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Identify refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Filter for completed orders that are not QA and not refunded
# Since 'completed' and 'refunded' are mutually exclusive, we only need to exclude QA
completed_non_qa = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = completed_non_qa['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")

# Confirm the number of completed orders after filtering
print(f"Number of completed orders after filtering: {len(completed_non_qa)}")"}
